The outlined treatment plan for Grace's osteoarthritis is highly appropriate and aligns with standard clinical guidelines. Osteoarthritis management typically focuses on symptom relief and improving joint function without invasive procedures. Taking over-the-counter pain relievers helps manage acute pain and inflammation. Low-impact aerobic exercises like swimming or biking are excellent choices because they maintain cardiovascular health and joint mobility while minimizing stress on the knee joints. Furthermore, physical therapy aimed at strengthening the muscles surrounding the knees provides better joint support, reduces load on the cartilage, and can significantly decrease pain and improve stability. This multimodal approach addresses both pain management and long-term joint health effectively.
